run_generate_demo_list: run the generate function to create a demo image list file with bounding box annotations
generate_image_list_with_boxes: generate a text list of PNG images from a directory with fixed bounding box coordinates
validate_image_count_in_dir: validate that a demo directory contains the expected number of PNG images before generating the list
review_generate_function: review the generate function that loads images, sorts them, and writes annotation list files
refactor_generate_to_accept_crop_params: refactor the generate function to accept configurable crop parameters instead of hardcoded values
